sql: SELECT strftime(first_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS first, strftime(last_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS last FROM corpus_stats WHERE dataset = $1

WITH grouped AS (SELECT log_events.component AS g1, count(*) AS events, NULL::BIGINT AS baseline FROM log_events WHERE log_events.dataset = $1 GROUP BY 1), ranked AS (SELECT g1, events, baseline, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY events DESC, g1 ASC NULLS LAST) AS rank, sum(events) OVER () AS total, sum(baseline) OVER () AS baseline_total FROM grouped), summary AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(events), 0) AS c, sum(baseline) AS b, coalesce(sum(greatest(events-baseline,0)),0) AS positive_delta, coalesce(sum(least(events-baseline,0)),0) AS negative_delta, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank > $2) AS other_n, coalesce(sum(events) FILTER (WHERE rank > $2), 0) AS other_c, sum(baseline) FILTER (WHERE rank > $2) AS other_b FROM ranked) SELECT 0::BIGINT AS rank, NULL AS g1, c::BIGINT AS events, NULL::DOUBLE AS share, b::BIGINT AS baseline, (c - b)::BIGINT AS delta, 100 * (c - b)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(b, 0) AS pct_change, CASE WHEN b IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN b = 0 AND c > 0 THEN 'first observed in this comparison' WHEN b = 0 THEN 'not observed in either period' WHEN c >= $3::BIGINT * b AND c - b >= $4::BIGINT THEN 'significantly increased' END AS classification, n::BIGINT AS group_count, other_n::BIGINT AS other_groups, other_c::BIGINT AS other_events, other_c::DOUBLE / NULLIF(c, 0) AS other_share, other_b::BIGINT AS other_baseline, (other_c - other_b)::BIGINT AS other_delta, 100 * (other_c - other_b)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(other_b, 0) AS other_pct_change, CASE WHEN FALSE THEN positive_delta END AS positive_delta, CASE WHEN FALSE THEN negative_delta END AS negative_delta, NULL::DOUBLE AS contribution_to_delta, 100 * (other_c-other_b)::DOUBLE / nullif(c-b,0) AS other_contribution_to_delta FROM summary UNION ALL SELECT rank, g1, events, events::DOUBLE / NULLIF(total, 0), baseline::BIGINT AS baseline, (events - baseline)::BIGINT AS delta, 100 * (events - baseline)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(baseline, 0) AS pct_change, CASE WHEN baseline IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN baseline = 0 AND events > 0 THEN 'first observed in this comparison' WHEN baseline = 0 THEN 'not observed in either period' WHEN events >= $3::BIGINT * baseline AND events - baseline >= $4::BIGINT THEN 'significantly increased' END AS classification, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 100 * (events-baseline)::DOUBLE / nullif(total-baseline_total,0), NULL FROM ranked WHERE rank <= $2 ORDER BY rank

WITH base AS (SELECT log_events.event_id AS event_id, log_events.message AS message, log_events.request_id AS request_id FROM log_events WHERE log_events.dataset = $1), extracted AS (SELECT event_id, unnest(regexp_extract_all(message, $2::VARCHAR, 0)) AS entity FROM base UNION ALL SELECT event_id, request_id AS entity FROM base WHERE request_id IS NOT NULL), pairs AS (SELECT DISTINCT event_id, entity FROM extracted WHERE TRUE AND TRUE), grouped AS (SELECT entity, count(*) AS events FROM pairs GROUP BY entity), ranked AS (SELECT entity, events, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY events DESC, entity ASC) AS rank FROM grouped), summary AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM base) AS total_events, (SELECT count(DISTINCT event_id) FROM pairs) AS matched_events, coalesce(sum(events),0) AS occurrences, count(*) AS distinct_entities, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rank > $3::BIGINT) AS other_entities, coalesce(sum(events) FILTER (WHERE rank > $3::BIGINT),0) AS other_events FROM ranked) SELECT 0::BIGINT AS rank, NULL::VARCHAR AS entity, 0::BIGINT AS events, NULL::DOUBLE AS share, total_events, matched_events, occurrences, distinct_entities, other_entities, other_events, other_events::DOUBLE / nullif(total_events,0) AS other_share FROM summary UNION ALL SELECT rank, entity, events, events::DOUBLE / nullif((SELECT total_events FROM summary),0), NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM ranked WHERE rank <= $3::BIGINT ORDER BY rank
